purpose: Estimate corpus-v5 MiniCPM5-2B seed stability after seed20 completed local hash verification, CUDA-to-MPS owned parity, and one-shot heldout reads. Seed20 improved heldout_v1 but remained below promotion gates on heldout_v2; two additional seeds are needed only to determine whether the repair-arm effect is stable. This document does not authorize promotion.

execution_policy.run_order: seed21 then seed22; do not run concurrently unless separately reviewed
execution_policy.local_heldout_read: one read per completed seed only after local hash verification and MPS FP32 owned parity

commands.seed21: .venv/bin/python scripts/train_pipeline_decisions_v4.py --input research/engineering_judgment_corpus_v5/trainer_view --output-dir /root/gpufree-data/nanojev/checkpoints/t9d_v7_minicpm2b_seed21_cuda --model openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B --revision 12a3808a956f869c767195e9266b59c4d21d92e2 --objective gold_distribution --loss ce --steps 600 --head-steps 12 --batch-questions 16 --microbatch-questions 4 --max-microbatch-tokens 32768 --eval-every 50 --max-length 2048 --seed 21 --lora-rank 16 --lora-alpha 32 --lora-dropout 0.05 --lora-lr 5e-5 --backbone-lr 0 --head-lr 2e-4 --head-warmup-lr 2e-3 --device cuda --precision bf16 --gradient-checkpointing
commands.seed22: .venv/bin/python scripts/train_pipeline_decisions_v4.py --input research/engineering_judgment_corpus_v5/trainer_view --output-dir /root/gpufree-data/nanojev/checkpoints/t9d_v7_minicpm2b_seed22_cuda --model openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B --revision 12a3808a956f869c767195e9266b59c4d21d92e2 --objective gold_distribution --loss ce --steps 600 --head-steps 12 --batch-questions 16 --microbatch-questions 4 --max-microbatch-tokens 32768 --eval-every 50 --max-length 2048 --seed 22 --lora-rank 16 --lora-alpha 32 --lora-dropout 0.05 --lora-lr 5e-5 --backbone-lr 0 --head-lr 2e-4 --head-warmup-lr 2e-3 --device cuda --precision bf16 --gradient-checkpointing
